Spacecraft name RSP-00

Units or mass 1U
Organisation Rymansat Project (Lehman Sat)
Institution Company
Entity type Commercial
Nation Japan
Launch brokerer JAXA
Oneliner

Launch messages collected from the public and amateur radio communications plus camera and high-speed transmitter.
Description
  • Launch messages collected from the public.
  • Send signal by Digitalker or Morse from the spacecraft and receive it with radio amateurs and children.
  • Hold a space science class using images taken by a camera carried on the spacecraft.
  • Conduct the experiment of high speed transmission of image data by π/4QPSK transmitter & receiver.
